snapshot: HPRC2 February 2025 human472.agc; not final Release 2
query_design: Fixed 10,000 x 1000-base reads per cohort sampled across all of paternal HG002 chr22; exact, 0.1% substitution, shuffled. Identical strings across all cells.
boundary_policy: Native mapped component intervals remain separate; split non-ACGT runs. No synthetic RagTag joins. Search both strands.
whole_policy: All original AGC contigs including unplaced and sex chromosomes; no inferred chromosome completion.
reuse_audit: Catalog checked 2026-09-22. Existing whole-genome prefix indexes include CHM13/GRCh38 and do not match this donor panel; no compatible chromosome indexes found.
note: Fig Rep series B above 100 haplotypes: the frozen panel extended by plan.py's rule to every r2_assemblies_only haplotype (CHM13 and GRCh38 removed), chr22 only
